name: Balance
facts: Lightly sparkling peach, blood orange & hops
Recycle our cans to protect our planet so it can keep protecting us.
Sparkling botanical drink with organic Chaga mushroom and added B vitamins.

Ingredients: Carbonated water, 20% apple juice from concentrate, natural flavourings, extracts (organic Chaga mushroom and ashwagandha), L-Tyrosine, acid (citric acid), antioxidant (ascorbic acid), vitamins (Niacin, B6, Biotin, B12).
Vitamins B3, B6, B7, B12 contribute to normal psychological function and the reduction of tiredness and fatigue.
Vitamins B3, B6, B7, B12 contribute to normal energy-yielding metabolism.
Do not exceed the recommended dose.
Not a substitute for a varied diet or healthy lifestyle.
Consult a GP if pregnant, breast-feeding or on medication.
Keep out of reach of young children.
Produced in the UK for OOM Drinks Ltd
Store in a cool dry place.
For Best Before, see base of can.
